name: Abreeza
location: J.P. Laurel Ave., Davao City
description: The lifestyle landmark in Southern Philippines. Abreeza Mall in Davao City features a vibrant and innovative design that seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor settings with sprawling spaces and lush greenery, giving the mall its breezy and resort-like feel. And as part of the 10-hectare mixed-use development, Abreeza offers premier retail, dining, and entertainment choices to its neighbors - Abreeza Corporate Center, Seda Abreeza, and residential developments.

name: Ayala Center Cebu
location: Cebu Business Park, Archbishop Reyes Ave. Cebu City 6000
description: The best of the Queen City of the South, in one place. Ayala Center Cebu offers retail, dining, and entertainment options that are unparalleled in the South. It leads seamlessly to The Terraces, a multi-level dining and entertainment enclave with a beautiful landscaped park, stunning greenery, and water features.

name: Ayala Malls Capitol Central
location: Gatuslao Street, Bacolod City
description: Strategically located at Negros Occidental’s Kilometer 0, Ayala Malls Capitol Central strengthens the Negrense tradition by showcasing the best home-grown concepts. Enhancing the shopping experience through a mix of local and global offerings, alongside it’s key features of the Fiesta Negrense, the Central Hall, the Food Choices, the Central Bazaar, the Chapel and the Corte, it becomes the perfect location to celebrate small winnings, major milestones, and intimate gatherings.

name: Ayala Malls Central Bloc
location: I. Villa Street, Cebu IT Park, Cebu City
description: The hub of the young urbanite, AyalaMalls Central Bloc  is a vibrant hang-out destination where the balance of work and play thrives. It features trending IT concepts, refreshing retail and dining outlets, and venues to chill out. It is Cebu’s HIP & HAPPENING BLOC.

name: Ayala Malls Circuit
location: Ayala Malls Circuit, Circuit Makati, Hippodromo, Carmona, Makati City
description: Makati’s speedway to entertainment. Ayala Malls Circuit offers a wealth of hip food finds, diverse shopping and entertainment options, world class event venues and sports facilities. A roof deck with a view of the city’s skyline delights the community along with the vibrance of a sprawling strip of al fresco specialty concepts surrounding the water feature that stretches to the whole development. Ayala Malls Circuit with its vivid scenery serves as an avenue where one can satisfy a fast-paced lifestyle.

name: Ayala Malls Cloverleaf
location: Ayala Malls Cloverleaf, A. Bonifacio Ave., Brgy. Balingasa, Quezon City
description: Fueling Businesses, Refreshing the Marketplace. Ayala Malls Cloverleaf invigorates and transforms Balintawak from a historical site to a convergence point, to a destination for retailers and wholesalers. It provides a new platform for local enterprises in search of fresh opportunities – allowing the community to grow and maintain its charm as uniquely Balintawak.

name: Ayala Malls Feliz
location: Amang Rodriguez cor. J.P. Rizal, Brgy. Dela Paz, Pasig City
description:
Your happy place to shop, dine and discover new adventures. 

We elevate the Eastern community by housing global brands. 

We delight by providing an array of casual dining restaurants where they can celebrate their everyday wins.

We energize them with the new concepts and an entertainment haven for the families that are looking to unwind.

name: Ayala Malls Legazpi
location: Rizal Street corner Quezon Ave., Barangay Capantawan, Legazpi City, Albay 4500
description: Situated at the heart of Legazpi City, Albay and the first Ayala mall in the entire region, it aims to be the mall of choice by offering and providing unique shopping, dining and entertainment experience to the Bicolanos. The building boasts of four-storey high atrium where one can admire the city’s majestic views of Mayon Volcano while enjoying Ayala Malls signature events.

name: Ayala Malls Manila Bay
location: Macapagal Blvd cor. Aseana Avenue, Paranaque City
description: Open up to the world and experience different cultures at Ayala Malls largest shopping mall to date

name: Ayala Malls Marikina
location: Liwasang Kalayaan, Brgy. Marikina Heights, Marikina City
description: Ayala Malls Marikina is a community hub that delivers comfort and convenience for Marikenos.

name: Ayala Malls Nuvali
location: Nuvali, Brgy. Sto. Domingo, City of Santa Rosa, Laguna
description: Where the sun meets the wind, Solenad is a pedestrian-friendly shopping and dining destination that celebrates the outdoors. Set amidst the natural environs of the NUVALI estate, it is a sprawling landscape of green and open spaces where outdoor recreational activities take place. It is home to a unique selection of homegrown al fresco dining concepts, offering a distinct dining experience for everyone.

name: Ayala Malls Serin
location: Gen. Emilio Aguinaldo Highway Brgy. Silang Crossing East Tagaytay City, Cavite 4120
description: More than just a mall, it’s a shopping and dining haven in the heart of Tagaytay City amicably built with contemporary structures and rustic designs that give quaintness vibe for a mall experience that is distinctively Tagaytay. It features an interactive garden at the atrium called the Corte where people can blissfully enjoy the city’s much-loved cold and fresh country-air. The mall is tidied with garden accents making it a wonderful place for families and friends to spend pleasurable moments together. Ayala Malls Serin is a home for convenience and comfort. It feels like home where you can get all what you love while enjoying the free-flowing cold breeze of Tagaytay City.

name: Ayala Malls The 30th
location: 30 Meralco Ave. Brgy. Ugong Pasig City 1604
description: Ayala Malls The 30th is a warm haven for young professionals, students and families of Pasig, helping them live their lives to the fullest. Ayala Malls The 30th is your sweet escape right in your backyard. Here, at this cozy neighborhood mall, you can pursue all your interests and truly live a good life.

name: Ayala Malls Vermosa
location: Ayala Malls Vermosa, along Daang Hari Road, corner Vermosa Boulevard, Brgy. Pasong Buaya – 1, Imus City, Cavite
description: Ayala Malls Vermosa is a 13-hectare regional mall that is strategically placed beside the Vermosa estate park and its principal terminal. Its retail facilities highlight health and sports-themed retail concept that is perfectly in tune with Vermosa’s spirit.

name: Ayala Malls Vertis North
location: Ayala Malls Vertis North, Phase 1 & 2, North Avenue, Brgy. Bagong Pag-asa, Q.C.
description: Ayala Malls Vertis North is the newest hangout of the passion-oriented, experience-seeking and socially active community of Quezon City. Home to two new and game-changing formats for dining and entertainment, the mall boasts of the A-Giant Screen, the country's largest movie screen with two private skyboxes; plus Japan Town and K-Town, two unique anchors carrying the popular and well-curated Japanese and Korean shopping and dining experience, all in one roof. Traversing the four retail buildings, The Garden offers a piece of nature and tranquility in the midst of the hustle and bustle of the city.

name: Bonifacio High Street
location: Bonifacio Global City, Taguig
description: A 1-kilometer-long boulevard line with exceptional shopping and dining options. Bonifacio High Street is the first ever shopping center in the country to introduce the main street concept. It is the home of a multitude of passions ranging from fashion, health and beauty, technology, home, dining and many others.

name: Centrio Mall
location: Centrio Mall, CM Recto – Corrales Avenue, Cagayan de Oro City 9000
description: Cagayan de Oro center of adventure, Centrio Mall reflects the city spirit for adventure with its first-in-CDO retail brands, home-grown dining concepts, and wide array of top-tier retail brands. Within this 3.7-hectare property is a unique shopping center and a cozy businessman hotel, making it your complete getaway destination this side of Southern Philippines.

name: Fairview Terraces
location: Quirino Highway corner Maligaya Drive, Barangay Pasong Putik Novaliches, Quezon City 1118
description: A refreshing lifestyle hub at the center of the bustling residential and commercial expanse of Fairview, Quezon City. Designed in the Ayala Malls' signature spirit of lush green settings, Fairview Terraces provides refreshing leisure offerings and a strong assortment of local and foreign brands that set the tone for a refreshing and relaxing mall experience.

name: Glorietta
location: Glorietta, Ayala Center, Makati City
description: The vibrant convergence point of the Makati Central Business District. Strategically located near prestigious office addresses, premier hotels, and main transport terminals, Glorietta occupies a central space in the lives of those in the business district. With its wide selection of shopping, dining, and entertainment offerings organized into strategic zones, Glorietta caters to the various needs of office workers, students, friends and families.

name: Greenbelt
location: Greenbelt Mall, Legazpi Street, Makati City
description: A sprawling 2.8-hectare garden amidst a world-class shopping and dining paradise. Greenbelt seamlessly integrates the indoor experience with the outdoor in its expansive 12-hectare space. Offering remarkable retail, dining, and entertainment options in the city, Greenbelt exemplifies the best of what the Ayala Malls has to offer.

name: Harbor Point
location: Subic Bay, Rizal Highway, Subic Bay Freeport Zone, 2200 Zambales
description: An invigorating retail experience where fresh trends, lively tastes and active fun coverage. Harbor Point is a lifestyle haven for both locals and tourists who regularly flock to Subic for a weekend escape or holiday. It offers a wealth of retail choices - local and foreign brands, active lifestyle stores, first in Subic concepts and hand-picked homegrown favorites.

name: Market! Market!
location: McKinley Parkway, Bonifacio Global City, Taguig 1634
description: Endless selections at affordable prices. Aside from the staple shopping, dining, and entertainment offerings, Market! Market! is home to a host of themed bazaars, a hawker's market, and a bounty of outlet and bargain stores. Oozing with character and brimming with energy; here great finds, exotic items, and a unique shopping experience is guaranteed.

name: MarQuee Mall
location: MarQuee Mall, Francisco G. Nepomuceno Avenue, Angeles City, Pampanga 2009
description: A beautiful mix of top foreign brands. first-in-Pampanga retail and lifestyle concepts, and local and homegrown stores. Marquee Mall in Angeles City, Pampanga, captures the festive spirit of the local culture while providing the trademark concepts and services of the Ayala Malls, making it one of the favorite gathering places in Central Luzon.

name: Metro Point Mall
location: Metropoint Mall, EDSA Corner Taft Avenue and Zamora Street, Pasay City, Metro Manila
description:
This shopping center serves as a convenient hub for commuters and shoppers alike. The mall is directly connected to both the EDSA station of the LRT Line 1 and the Taft Avenue station of the MRT Line 3, facilitating easy access to public transportation. 

Metropoint Mall offers a variety of retail shops, dining options, and services. Additionally, the mall features a range of food establishments, from fast-food outlets to casual dining restaurants, catering to diverse culinary preferences. 

For those driving to the mall, parking facilities are available on-site. The mall's strategic location and connectivity make it a practical stop for both shopping and transit needs in Metro Manila.

name: One Ayala
location: #1 Ayala Avenue corner EDSA, Ayala Center Makati
description: A dynamic retail experience set in a world-class transit hub at the gateway of Makati

name: One Bonifacio High Street
location: 5th Ave. Corner 28th BGC, Taguig City Located along 5th Ave. beside PSE Building Near The Shangri-La at The Fort and The Mind Museum
description:
Something new comes to Bonifacio Global City, one that epitomizes its vision as the Home of Passionate Minds and brings its live-work-play promise to life. 


One Bonifacio High Street, located along 5th Avenue and standing alongside the unified headquarters of the Philippine Stock Exchange, landmark five-star hotel Shangri-La at The Fort, and posh residential tower The Suites by Ayala Land Premier, is a stunning five-level lifestyle mall that is home to exciting additions to BGC’s retail line-up: fashion powerhouse Zara, New York’s famous M Bakery and Wolfgang’s Steakhouse, and Instagram-worthy Hong Kong Café Elephant Grounds, as well as an art-deco inspired, curated dining hall, Food District Signatures by the Foodee Global Concepts Group.

It is BGC’s crown jewel, the final puzzle piece that completes Bonifacio High Street as a one-kilometer retail expanse—the city’s shopping, dining and entertainment center piece, where all street life culminates.

name: Pavilion Mall
location: Ayala Pavilion Mall Bldg. A, Binan, Laguna

name: Shops at Serendra
location: Serendra, 11th Ave., Bonifacio Global City, Taguig
description: Shops at Serendra is the retail piazza within the Serendra residential complex. It houses a good mix of cafes, restaurants, and shops for the comfort and convenience of the community.

name: The District Dasmarinas
location: Molino-Paliparan Road, Brgy. Salawag, Dasmarinas City, Cavite
description:
The Ayala Malls brand of community centers where friends and families can converge and where office worker relax. The District complements nearby communities and office spaces with convenient and pleasant retail and dining experiences. Featuring popular local and foreign brands, the best homegrown concepts, and an assortment of services. The District centers to the basic, everyday needs of the communities it serves.

Located in the suburban area of Cavite, The District Dasmarinas plays the role of the go-to place for basic shopping and services of the residential developments in the area.

name: The District Imus
location: Aguinaldo Highway cor. Daang Hari Road Anabu II-D, Imus, Cavite
description:
The Ayala Malls brand of community centers where friends and families can converge and where office worker relax. The District complements nearby communities and office spaces with convenient and pleasant retail and dining experiences. Featuring popular local and foreign brands, the best homegrown concepts, and an assortment of services. The District centers to the basic, everyday needs of the communities it serves.

Provides a dynamic gathering place where office workers in the BPO site within the development, as well as the residents of the neighboring communities can bond and interact in the highly urbanized province of Cavite.

name: Trinoma
location: Trinoma EDSA cor. North Avenue, QC
description: A sanctuary of retail and relaxation north of the metropolis. Trinoma is characterized by the convergence of spacious interiors, soothing landscapes, and of course, diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options. A 1-hectare bi-level rooftop garden awaits commuters, students, residents, and office workers hailing from the nearby communities, or just about anyone in need of an escape..

name: U. P. Town Center
location: 249, U.P. Town Center, 216 Katipunan Ave., Diliman, Quezon City
description: The pioneer university town concept in the country and a playground for curious minds. UP Town Center plays host to the two major universities and educational institutions, as well as residential villages along Katipunan Avenue, Quezon City. With its distinctive dining and retail options complemented by lush landscaping and greenery, UP Town Center will continue to expand to serve as a place for social interaction, relaxation and convergence, as well as a venue for creative expression and performing arts
